description: This file implements the PrioritizedTaskRunner class, managing prioritized task execution with reply handling, using thread pools and heap-based priority queues.

classes.name: PrioritizedTaskRunner::Job
classes.description: Represents a task with priority, including task and reply closures, and associated metadata.

classes.name: PrioritizedTaskRunner
classes.description: Manages prioritized execution of tasks with reply callbacks, using thread pools and heap-based priority queues.

methods.name: PrioritizedTaskRunner::PostTaskAndReply
methods.description: Posts a task with a reply callback, adding it to the priority queue based on priority.

methods.name: PrioritizedTaskRunner::RunTaskAndPostReply
methods.description: Executes the highest priority task and queues its reply.

methods.name: PrioritizedTaskRunner::RunReply
methods.description: Executes the reply callback for the next completed task.
